                                         BASEMENT

                                           NOTICE
       Members of the public who wish to comment on an agenda item may speak for up to
       one minute per item. Members of the public who wish to comment on matters not listed
       on the agenda and under the jurisdiction of the Commission may offer up to two minutes
       of general public comment.

       The Neighborhood Council representative may provide the Neighborhood Council’s
       formal position (a Community Impact Statement filed with the City Clerk or a written
       Resolution) regarding any matter listed on the agenda during the Neighborhood Council
       Comments portion of the agenda (Los Angeles Administrative Code Section 22.819).

      • FY26 Operations Update

      • Partner Updates on Programming and Events
             - El Pueblo Museums, nonprofit partners
             - People Concern

2.   COMMISSION COMMITTEE REPORTS

     • Mexican-American/Latino Historical Monuments Ad Hoc Committee
     • El Pueblo Parking Operations and Revenue Ad Hoc Committee

3.   DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE ACTION ITEMS


     3.1 Dept. of Transportation LADOT Holiday Moratorium Exemption Request:
     Spring/Alameda Safety and Mobility Project
     3.2 Approval of Key Terms and Authorization to Execute a Lease Agreement with
     Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México, USA (UNAM USA) for the Second Floor of
     the Sepulveda House
     3.3 Approval of Recommendation to Authorize a Temporary Right of Entry for the Olvera
     Street Merchants Association Foundation Representative
     3.4 Approval of Parking Ad Hoc Committee Findings and Parking System Modernization
     Update and vote to dissolve Parking Ad Hoc Committee
     3.5 Approval of lease of C-10 to Dorkas Ramirez, Ramirez Toys
     3.6 Approval of lease of E-15, Rafael Cortez-Flores, Mercado Raices
     3.7 Approval of lease of W-8, Hanna Silva, Mother of Healing
     3.8 Recommendation to Approve the Design and Installation of Wrought Iron Entrance
     Security Gates at Olvera Street

     COMMISSION BUSINESS

     Comments from Commissioners on matters within the Commission’s jurisdiction and
     requests by Commissioners to schedule specific future agenda Items.

ADJOURNMENT
Upcoming Meetings: 10/8/26,10/22/26,11/12/26


                                     Meeting Rules

Interpretation. Sign language interpreters, Communication Access Real-Time
Transcription (CART), assistive listening devices, or other auxiliary aids and services
may be provided upon request. To ensure availability, please make your request at
least 72 hours prior to the meeting you wish to attend. Due to difficulties in securing
sign language interpreters, five or more business days of notice is strongly
recommended. For additional information, please contact Property Management at
(213) 485-9777 (voice and TTY).

Notice to paid representatives. If you are compensated to monitor, attend, or speak
at this meeting, City law may require you to register as a lobbyist and report your
activity. See Los Angeles Municipal Code 48.01 et seq. More information is available
at: ethics.lacity.org/lobbying. For assistance, please contact the Ethics Commission at:
(213) 978-1960 or ethics.commission@lacity.org.
